description: CsNaNbOF₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcn space group. There are two inequivalent Cs sites. In the first Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to two equivalent O and ten F atoms. Both Cs-O bond lengths are 3.34 Å. There are a spread of Cs-F bond distances ranging from 3.02-3.67 Å. In the second Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to two equivalent O and eight F atoms. Both Cs-O bond lengths are 3.37 Å. There are a spread of Cs-F bond distances ranging from 3.11-3.58 Å. Na is bonded to one O and five F atoms to form NaOF₅ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NbOF₅ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one NbOF₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-41°. The Na-O bond length is 2.34 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.44 Å. Nb is bonded to one O and five F atoms to form NbOF₅ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaOF₅ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaOF₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-41°. The Nb-O bond length is 1.78 Å. There are a spread of Nb-F bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.15 Å. O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Cs, one Na, and one Nb atom. There are five inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Cs, one Na, and one Nb atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Cs, one Na, and one Nb atom. In the third F site, F is bonded to two Cs, one Na, and one Nb atom to form distorted corner-sharing FCs₂NaNb tetrahedra. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two Cs, one Na, and one Nb atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Cs, one Na, and one Nb atom.
